import heapq

def main():
    N = int(input())
    inf = 10 ** 10
    times = [inf] * N
    times[0] = 0
    A = []
    B = []
    X = []
    
    for _ in range(N - 1):
        Ai, Bi, Xi = map(int, input().split())
        A.append(Ai)
        B.append(Bi)
        X.append(Xi - 1)  # Adjust for 0-based index
    
    pq = []
    heapq.heappush(pq, (0, 0))  # (time, stage)
    
    while pq:
        current_time, stage = heapq.heappop(pq)
        
        if stage == N - 1:
            break
        
        # Move to the next stage
        if stage + 1 < N and current_time + A[stage] < times[stage + 1]:
            times[stage + 1] = current_time + A[stage]
            heapq.heappush(pq, (times[stage + 1], stage + 1))
        
        # Move to the stage unlocked by the second action
        if current_time + B[stage] < times[X[stage]]:
            times[X[stage]] = current_time + B[stage]
            heapq.heappush(pq, (times[X[stage]], X[stage]))
    
    print(times[N - 1])
